questions.question: When you type a request for a thread and hit the new 'ask manager' button, what should happen?

options.label: One-off Q&A, answer inline
options.description: Runs a claude -p investigator with the thread's context + your question and shows its answer right there in the detail pane. Ephemeral (not cached). Best for 'what about X?' / 'check Y' on the spot.

options.label: Custom analysis → MANAGER/SESSION rec
options.description: Like Analyze, but seeded with your prompt. Updates the Recommendation fields (rec_manager/rec_session), so you can then '→ send to session' or '▷ run manager rec'. Cached like a normal analysis.

options.label: Queue a standing instruction
options.description: Saves your note on the thread so the autonomous manager --loop reads it and acts on it next cycle. No immediate answer in the UI.
